method.population_rule: Use candidate.start against exact source offsets, because this cached run mislabeled Results candidates as ABSTRACT.
method.unit_of_judgment: Complete proposed claim: actor, relation, target, polarity, modality/uncertainty, comparison, intervention arm, time, and material source context.

verdicts.complete_supported: The proposition is source-supported as stated, including material scope. Methods and caption metadata are allowed valid extra propositions beyond biological gold.
verdicts.incomplete_qualifiers: Core relation is source-supported but a material qualifier needed to interpret it is omitted.
verdicts.unsupported: The source does not establish the proposed independent or over-specific relation.
verdicts.ambiguous: Source-literal assertion is materially contradicted elsewhere in Results or the corrected audit flags the conflict.

method.evidence_rule: Every item contains an exact substring of the source text; absence from biological gold alone never makes a proposal unsupported.
method.precision_interpretation: Conservative complete-claim precision counts ambiguous and incomplete as not established. This is a Codex audit, not independent human evaluation or a held-out release result.
